title: Viewing pipeline logs by using the OpenShift Logging Operator
abstract: Pipeline runs, task runs, and event listeners store their logs in their pods. It is useful to review and analyze logs for troubleshooting and audits. However, retaining the pods indefinitely leads to unnecessary resource consumption and cluttered namespaces. To remove any dependency on the pods for viewing pipeline logs, you can use the OpenShift Elasticsearch Operator and the OpenShift Logging Operator.
additional_resources: Viewing cluster logs by using Kibana - https://docs.openshift.com/container-platform/latest/logging/cluster-logging-visualizer.html
